items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So my name is Monk Rowe and I am with the Fillius Jazz Archive and we are in Boston at the City Winery and I’m very pleased to have James Hunter here with me.

ctx.x: James Hunter was born on October 2, 1962 in Colchester, England. His distinctive voice and guitar skills and knack for composing memorable R&B songs have made the James Hunter Six a popular act in Great Britain and the U.S. His 2006 release “People Gonna Talk” was nominated for a Grammy Award in the Traditional Blues category.
James was interviewed by Monk Rowe before a gig at the City Winery in Boston, MA on July 25, 2018. Romy Britell also participated in the interview.
